title: Chapter 9
text: II The ignorant Looker-on can’t imagine what the Limner means by those seemingly rude Lines and Scrawls, which he intends for the Rudiments of a Picture, and the figures of Mathematick Operation are Nonsense, and Dashes at a Venture, to one un-instructed in Mechanicks. We are in the Dark to one another’s Purposes and Intendments; and there are a thousand Intrigues in our little Matters, which will not presently confess their Design, even to sagacious Inquisitors. Joseph Glanvil: Sadducismus Triumphatus
